newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds little changed, quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds little changed, quiet.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were little changed on Friday on a quiet market, but buyers were slowing more interest.
"We have had a fair amount of interest from the country trade, but people are not comfortable with current prices," said one broker.
"However, once prices reach a level with which the buyers are happy we can see a good trade building up for the winter months," the broker added.
High protein soymeal was offered one stg down to unchanged ex-mill while stores were mostly unchanged.
All other sectors of the market were unchanged from Thursday levels.
